maya: Quick oddball: after converting Llama->Gemma with auto-vocab-map we see sentinel token (|SENT|) sometimes swallowed when followed by a ZWJ emoji sequence. Happens only after int4-fast quant. Float32 OK. Anyone seen a sentinel/ZWJ combo be fragile?
devin: can you paste minimal prompt and quant flags? also which `map-heads`?
maya: repro: prompt: `Please redact: |SENT|‍👩‍🏼` (ZWJ family). convert: `lm-convert --src llama.safetensors --tgt gemma.safetensors --vocab-map auto --map-heads auto`. quant: `qtool int4 --mode fast --backend our-kernel`.
ml-bot: quick eval: float32 keeps sentinel in 100% samples; int4-fast drops sentinel in ~0.8% and sometimes yields extra space or duplicate emoji. logging id t-2026-92.
harry: sounds like token-id remap + quant distortion on first rotary index after sentinel. two quick experiments: 1) run `qtool int4 --preserve-ids` 2) convert with `--preserve-rotary` then quantize.
ian: also check if converter collapsed sentinel into neighboring token due to bytepair boundary change. run `token-diff --check-sentinel` to see if id moved.
maya: ran preserve-ids: sentinel preserved in 99.9% but still occasional spacing. preserve-rotary fixed spacing but preserve-ids more effective.
devin: ok that points to two issues: vocab remap shifts offsets; rotary/quant noise amplifies boundary decoding. action items: add conversion lint for sentinel/ZWJ remap and add warmup recommendation. i'll file a tiny PR.
ml-bot: labels: `sentinel-zwj`, `vocab-risk`, `quant-amplification`. assigned to @devin.
maya: thanks all. i'll add the minimal repro to ticket and run a larger eval with preserve-ids+precise-kernel. :thumbsup:
